name: frac-price-increase-plan
description: Plans a fee increase across the clients of a fractional leader, with the current fee against your floor per client, the value delivered with evidence, the new fee you set, timing and notice from the contract, what changes for the client, the order of conversations, what you do with the days if one client leaves, and the points for each conversation in your own words. Use for "run frac-price-increase-plan", "raise my retainer", "I keep putting off a fee increase", "raise rates as a fractional executive", "plan a price increase for my clients", "how much notice do I give", "which client do I tell first", part of the Claude for Fractional Leaders Pack by 90n.
